packageRules.description: The upstream collector is pinned by commit and carries three local patches. A bump is exactly the moment those patches can break, and the build applies them with -F0, so the PR check is the test. Never automerged: a green build still means reading the diff.
prBodyNotes: :warning: This bump re-applies `patches/01-configparser-no-interpolation.patch`, `patches/02-refuse-force-sync-workaround.patch` and `patches/03-log-exception-class.patch`. A failing build means one of them no longer applies. Patch 02 is the guard that stops the car being woken: do not merge without it in the built image.

packageRules.description: The API client is the login path. Patch bumps have fixed and broken that login before now, so they land as a PR that must be read.

Python itself: the collector needs >=3.12 and the working host install is 3.12.12, so stay on the 3.12 series. Patch bumps automerge; a minor bump inside 3.12 would be reviewed, and 3.13+ is not offered at all -- a 3.14 image builds green while quietly moving off the interpreter this was verified on.
